name: Framer Agents
desc: AI agents that design, write and edit sites on the canvas
desc_zh: 在画布上设计、写文案、改网站的 AI 智能体
solves: Small teams wait on a designer for every copy and layout change. Agents make the edit in the same canvas and keep it editable.
solves_zh: 小团队每改一句文案、一个版式都要等设计师。Agent 就在同一张画布上改，改完还是可编辑的图层。
best_for: A landing page needs new copy tonight and no designer is free to touch it.
best_for_zh: 落地页今晚就要换新文案，而设计师今晚排不出时间来动手。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.framer.com/updates and https://www.framer.com/blog/ (Framer's re）。 Launched as part of Framer 3.0 on 2026-06-16. Distinct from the ledger's 'Framer AI' prompt-to-site entry (2023-06-14): Agents edit the same canvas, components, CMS and styles a team already uses, and were later extended by Skills (2026-09-22). Independent coverage exists (Product Hunt launch 2026-06-17, 482 upvotes) but was not needed for the date. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.framer.com/blog/ai-credits-simpler-plans-and-lower-prices/
